NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: App icon
patches.description: Choose a classic or premium-style launcher icon.

options.title: Style
options.description: Icon shown on your home screen.

patches.name: Bypass Login Requirements
patches.description: Skips SofaScore login requirement by forcing isLoggedIn to true.

patches.name: Bypass in-app purchase
patches.description: Best-effort local Play Billing bypass for offline games (Purchase state = PURCHASED, acknowledged = true). Does not defeat server-side validation.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Sets a custom application / launcher display name (strings.xml + manifest labels).

options.title: App name
options.description: Display name shown under the launcher icon.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Appends ".mightymich" to the package name by default. Changing the package name of the app can lead to unexpected issues.

options.title: Package name
options.description: The name of the package to rename the app to. "Default" appends ".mightymich" to the original package.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Rewrite package-scoped custom permissions. Fixes some install errors; can break features in certain apps.

options.title: Update providers
options.description: Rewrite provider android:authorities that start with the old package name. Fixes some install errors; can break features.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Overrides android:versionCode (and optional versionName).

options.title: Version code
options.description: Integer versionCode to write into the manifest.

patches.name: Disable ads (basic)
patches.description: Best-effort no-op of common ad SDK load/show methods.

patches.name: Disable all telemetry
patches.description: Best-effort disable of Firebase/AppsFlyer/Mixpanel/Segment style track methods.

patches.name: Disable screenshot restriction
patches.description: Best-effort bypass of FLAG_SECURE screenshot blocks.

patches.name: Disable signature verification
patches.description: Allows re-signed MiXplorer builds by adding the installed signing cert fingerprint to the internal allow-list.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Reduces Adjust / analytics style callbacks where possible. Flutter Sentry/Amplitude may still run partially.

patches.name: Enable premium license
patches.description: Best-effort unlock of ESET premium UI / client-side license flags. Native libems + server checks may still limit some features.

patches.name: Fix video engine on re-sign
patches.description: Stops libisvideoengine.so from terminating the process after the APK is re-signed. Supports arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a; patterns cover 2.214.x and newer builds that still issue kill(pid, 9).

patches.name: Force region
patches.description: Forces TikTok store_region-related getters to a chosen ISO country code.

options.title: Region (ISO country)
options.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code to spoof (e.g. US, GB, JP, KR, PL).

patches.name: Hide browser Download component
patches.description: Removes DownloadActivity intent-filters so MiXplorer is not offered in browser/Firefox download choosers.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Show messages that were deleted for everyone. May need a fingerprint update after WhatsApp upgrades.

options.title: Highlight deleted messages
options.description: Mark deleted messages so they are easier to spot.

patches.name: Limit Copy to share menu
patches.description: Removes CopyActivity VIEW filters (open-with) while keeping SEND filters so Copy remains in the system share menu.

patches.name: Mods settings entry
patches.description: Reserves a MightyMich row in Settings. Full dialog wiring needs the settings-list fingerprint for this WhatsApp build.

patches.name: Mods settings resources
patches.description: Adds English strings for the MightyMich section in WhatsApp Settings.

patches.name: Read receipts
patches.description: If enabled, you won't send read receipts (blue ticks).

options.title: Always off
options.description: Always disable read receipts, ignoring the in-app toggle.

patches.name: Remove HTTP/HTTPS intent filters
patches.description: Strips http/https schemes from VIEW/BROWSABLE intent-filters so MiXplorer is not offered for web links.

patches.name: Remove INTERNET permission
patches.description: Removes INTERNET / ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions from the manifest.

patches.name: Remove Internet permission (Nova)
patches.description: Removes INTERNET permission from Nova Launcher and disables network-only entry points so Nova does not crash.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables common TikTok ad load/show methods (best-effort).

patches.name: Spoof device & network
patches.description: Spoofs device model/manufacturer, hides common root/emulator signals, and can force simple in-app network type checks.

options.title: Device model
options.description: Value for model-style getters, e.g. Pixel 8. Empty = leave unchanged.

options.title: Manufacturer
options.description: Value for manufacturer-style getters, e.g. Google. Empty = leave unchanged.

options.title: Hide root
options.description: Force common isRooted / RootBeer / su-check methods to return false.

options.title: Hide emulator
options.description: Force common isEmulator checks to return false.

options.title: Connection type
options.description: Best-effort force of in-app network type / connected helpers.

patches.name: Typing indicator
